matched.description: True only for exactly one matching transfer after required finality.

network.description: Blockchain inspected; the separate API payment always settles native USDC on Base.

description: Confirm an exact native Circle USDC recipient and six-decimal transfer amount for a completed transaction on a supported EVM chain or Solana, with chain-specific finality checks. Use when reconciling a payment with an expected wallet and amount; for inspecting a transfer without expected values choose verify_native_usdc; for a PDF choose usdc_transfer_evidence_pdf. Requires tx_hash, recipient and amount, does not send funds or create an invoice. Costs 0.03 USDC via x402 v2; paid MCP wallets can pay native USDC on Base or Solana.

amount.description: Positive exact USDC decimal string, at most six decimal places. Never a floating point number.

network.description: Blockchain inspected; the separate API payment always settles native USDC on Base.

recipient.description: Expected recipient: EVM 0x address or Solana owner wallet, not a token account.

tx_hash.description: Public transaction to inspect: 0x plus 64 hex characters for EVM; base58 64-byte Solana signature. Must match network.

name: match_native_usdc_payment
title: Match exact USDC recipient and amount
